result.scope: Focused author supplemental-attribution replay; not independent review or a repeated full chemistry replay

exact_six_assertion_deltas.before: Tneu_1204 is a candidate pyruvate-water dikinase in Table 1; the measured activity is from extract, not purified Tneu_1204.
exact_six_assertion_deltas.after: Cell-extract pyruvate-water dikinase activity was assayed at 80°C with ATP and pyruvate; PEP formation was determined in a discontinuous coupled assay.

exact_six_assertion_deltas.before: Tneu_0418 is the Table 1 candidate PEP carboxylase; activity is demonstrated in extract, not purified Tneu_0418.
exact_six_assertion_deltas.after: Cell-extract PEP carboxylase activity was measured by coupling to endogenous malate dehydrogenase and independently by a radiochemical bicarbonate assay.

exact_six_assertion_deltas.before: Tneu_1509 is the Table 1 candidate malate dehydrogenase; the NADH-dependent reaction is demonstrated in extract.
exact_six_assertion_deltas.after: Cell-extract malate dehydrogenase activity was detected as oxaloacetate-dependent NADH oxidation.

exact_six_assertion_deltas.before: Table 1 assigns Tneu_1334/1335 as putative fumarate-hydratase subunits. The direct activity is in extract; individual subunit sufficiency and exact assembly stoichiometry were not measured.
exact_six_assertion_deltas.after: Cell-extract fumarate hydratase activity was measured anaerobically using D,L-malate as substrate.

exact_six_assertion_deltas.after: Cell-extract fumarate hydratase activity was measured anaerobically using D,L-malate as substrate.

exact_six_assertion_deltas.before: Tneu_0541 is a candidate hydratase/dehydrogenase fusion identified by domain similarity. The purified native and recombinant enzyme tested in this section is Msed_0399, not Tneu_0541.
exact_six_assertion_deltas.after: Domain-similarity searches identified candidate fusion proteins Msed_0399, Tneu_0541 and Igni_1058, with an enoyl-CoA hydratase C-terminal domain and a dehydrogenase N-terminal domain.
